print(a.check_move((4, 4)))
print(b.check_move((5, 5)))
print(c.check_move((6, 6)))

question_snapshot.explanation: The first move fails because the row and column differences are both 4, which is above the allowed maximum of 3. The second fails because a straight-only piece cannot move diagonally. The third succeeds because a piece that can move straight and diagonally may move along the same column within 3 steps, so exactly one result is True.
